sourceReview.reason: This weekly roundup repeats J.P. Morgan Asset Management’s October 22 expansion of MONY and JLTXX to Solana, already verified and published from the issuer’s primary release; its tokenized-stock references are recap material, not a new launch, approval, financing or material expansion.
